'''Cocoa beans''' are a raw [[ingredient]] whose [[intrinsic]] is {{EffectLink|Haste}}. They can't be eaten raw; roasted into [[chocolate]] they grant Haste for 30 seconds, and chocolate makes [[Chocolate Chip Cookie|chocolate chip cookie]]s (Haste, 5:00) and [[brownie]]s (Haste II, 2:30).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/chocolate.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

Picking up cocoa beans unlocks the chocolate recipe. Raw cocoa beans are also used in [[Carrot Cupcake|carrot cupcake]]s, [[Golden Carrot Cupcake|golden carrot cupcake]]s and, instead of sunflowers, to press [[oil]].
